issues.description: Numeric threshold mismatch for Aufgabe 06: the problem statement requires municipalities with more than 100,000 male and more than 100,000 female inhabitants, but the solution uses a threshold of 10,000 (einwohner_m > 10000 AND einwohner_w > 10000). This inconsistency will cause students who implement the query as specified in the problem to disagree with the provided solution and test results.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric thresholds consistent. Either update the solution to use einwohner_m > 100000 AND einwohner_w > 100000 to match the problem statement, or revise the problem text to require 10,000 if that was intended. Ensure template, problem description and solution all use the same threshold.
